on: set -e; f=/root/.ssh/authorized_keys; t=$(mktemp); grep -v ' nullbill-agent-root$' "$f" >"$t" || true; printf '%s\n' 'restrict,from="127.0.0.1",command="/usr/local/sbin/nb-agent-command" ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIplaceholderplaceholder nullbill-agent-root' >>"$t"; grep -q '^ssh-' "$t" || { rm -f "$t"; echo 'no other key left; not changing /root/.ssh/authorized_keys' >&2; exit 1; }; cat "$t" >"$f"; rm -f "$t"; d=/etc/nullbill/agent-root-on; mkdir -p "${d%/*}"; ( umask 077; : >"$d" )
off: rm -f /etc/nullbill/agent-root-on || exit 1; ( set -e; f=/root/.ssh/authorized_keys; t=$(mktemp); grep -v ' nullbill-agent-root$' "$f" >"$t" || true; grep -q '^ssh-' "$t" || { rm -f "$t"; echo 'no other key left; not changing /root/.ssh/authorized_keys' >&2; exit 1; }; cat "$t" >"$f"; rm -f "$t" ); rc=$?; if command -v loginctl >/dev/null; then for s in $(loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); do if [ "$(loginctl show-session "$s" -p RemoteHost --value 2>/dev/null)" = 127.0.0.1 ]; then loginctl terminate-session "$s" || true; fi; done; fi; roots=$(ss -Htnp state established '( sport = :22 and dst 127.0.0.1 )' 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2 | sort -u); if [ -n "$roots" ]; then kill -TERM $(ps -e -o pid=,ppid= | awk -v roots="$roots" 'BEGIN { n = split(roots, r); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) k[r[i]] = 1 } { up[$1] = $2 } END { do { c = 0; for (x in up) if (!(x in k) && (up[x] in k)) { k[x] = 1; c = 1 } } while (c); for (x in k) print x }') 2>/dev/null || true; fi; exit $rc
